eva: Quick sync — we need to lock the enterprise compliance launch gates for Q3. Focus areas: audit logs (retention tiers + immutable snapshots), BYOK/KMS handshake, SOC2 evidence packaging, and export SLAs. @carla @dinesh can you weigh in with minimal MVP we can commit to?

dinesh: MVP idea: default retention 90d hot, per-tenant override up to 7y. Export format NDJSON + signed metadata. BYOK handshake v1: customer provides public key, we wrap a per-tenant DEK and store it.

carla: Security: default 90d is fine for most customers, but we must support legal-hold that freezes deletion and a WORM-ish append-only mode for certain tenants. Also require tamper-evidence for exported packages.

marta: From onboarding: customers ask for a clear runbook and guaranteed export SLA for discovery requests — many finserv/legal teams demand 24h exports.

tom (legal): 24h is tight. Legal can accept 72h for initial GA but prefers 24h for high-risk customers. Exports must include chain-of-custody statement and signature.

dinesh: Operational note: 7y cold storage is fine but hot storage cost explodes. Proposal: hot 90d, warm 2y, cold archive to deep storage up to 7y (Glacier/nearline) with retrieval SLA 48–72h. To hit 24h export SLA we need precomputed daily signed snapshots for opted customers.

eva: OK — proposed launch gates:
- Gate 1: Core audit capture + per-tenant retention policy + basic BYOK handshake + export format v1 (NDJSON + metadata).
- Gate 2: Legal-hold UI + retention override RBAC + signed snapshot job + export packaging.
- Gate 3: SOC2 evidence mapping + evidence runbook + 2-customer pilot (paying pilot for fast export).

carla: Add to Gate 2: tamper-evidence requirement — merkle root for each snapshot signed by KMS/HSM and stored in hardened store. Also audit of KMS access logs.

dinesh: Implementation detail: snapshot flow = gather tenant events -> sort by event_ts -> compute merkle root -> sign with asymmetric key in KMS -> store snapshot blob in archive + store merkle root and signature in secure index. Estimated snapshot job CPU: ~30m per 100GB; we need quotas for pilot customers.

marta: For customers who need 24h, propose a paid 'fast-export' tier: keep daily snapshots hot (rolling 7 days) and pre-bundle evidence. That limits cost to opted customers.

eva: Launch criteria checklist (first pass):
``
- [ ] Core audit ingestion (100% of prod routes)
- [ ] Per-tenant retention policy UI & API
- [ ] BYOK handshake v1 implemented + KMS audit trail
- [ ] Export format v1 (NDJSON) + metadata + chain-of-custody template
- [ ] Signed snapshot job (daily) + merkle root signing
- [ ] Legal-hold freeze & RBAC controls
- [ ] SOC2 evidence mapping doc + runbook reviewed by Security & Legal
- [ ] Pilot with 2 customers (1 finserv) committed
- [ ] Billing toggle for fast-export tier
``

carla: I'm +1 on checklist but require an explicit acceptance test for tamper-evidence: demo verifying signature verification and mismatch detection.

dinesh: I'll sketch an infra cost estimate and pilot capacity plan by EOD. Need decision on snapshot frequency (daily vs hourly) for opted customers.

eva: Action items:
- dinesh -> infra cost + pilot capacity estimate (due EOD)
- carla -> acceptance test matrix for tamper-evidence + SOC2 controls (due Tue)
- marta -> pilot outreach + pricing for fast-export (due Tue)
- tom (legal) -> approve chain-of-custody template (due Wed)
- ops-bot -> create tracking epic and add these gates to release criteria

marta: noted. I'll line up two pilot customers and draft pricing.

dinesh: got it, will ping with numbers.

eva: Thanks team — if no major objections I'll lock these gates by EOD and schedule the pilot kickoff. :thumbsup:
